description: Create an asynchronous social-copy generation job. Opus produces a platform-specific title, description, and hashtags for a clip + destination account. Returns a jobId — poll opus_get_social_copy_job until status is "COMPLETED" or "FAILED".

forceRegenerate.description: If true, bypass the cached result for this clip/account pair.

prompt.description: Optional style or tone instruction (e.g. "playful and witty").

name: opus_create_social_copy_job
